Feature: Is ergative alignment of flagging conditioned by any other factor?
Comment: There are three ergative-case markers: -gin, -wurri and -nganan. The first one marks a "pragmatically marked" A, that is, an unsual or unexpected A. The second one marks an A in the context of a verb than involves some kind of transfer from A to P; sometimes, it marks the "culprit" of the action. The last marks that A performed the action under their own volition.
